value.rationale: The exact geometric fixed-space homotopy of the two natural perpendicular mirrors in a currently studied grid-matching family is a symmetry-sensitive topological invariant not fixed by existing Lefschetz character formulas. The 3-by-8 width is a motivated finite cutoff: exhaustive checks for even widths 2,4,6 show it is the first tested even width with more than one same-degree sphere in the column-fixed geometry, contrasting sharply with row-fixed contractibility. Integral attaching information, not a routine trace or small parameter substitution, resolves the homotopy classification.
